scripts.audit: npm audit && npm audit --prefix server && npm audit --prefix client
scripts.test:api: echo 'Add: cd server && npx vitest run'
scripts.test:api:fast: echo 'Add: cd server && npx vitest run --testNamePattern ^(?!.*[slow]).*'
scripts.test:spa: echo 'Add: cd client && npx vitest run'
scripts.test:spa:fast: echo 'Add: cd client && npx vitest run --testNamePattern ^(?!.*[slow]).*'
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:spa
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:spa && echo 'Add: coverage + build'
